_about: 古六's boards (h08; the per-回 plan 2026-10-15, Hanli 「可以，开工，先做古六」): each the book's own action where its scene stands; every one skippable (算了，往下走), and every one pays what the plan names — 修为 for cultivation (掐诀, 藏息, 让一拳, 等风掉头, 念开篇), 灵石 / a thing / a 恩仇簿 line for the rest.

title.en: Three days in the lecture hall · Pinch, chant, hold

done_line.en: Pinch, chant, hold — you have all three.

done_line.zh: 五句，背下来了。对面出什么，你手里都有吃它的那一样。
done_line.en: Five lines by heart. Whatever comes, you hold what eats it.

tasks._reward: 灵石 +3 (the plan: a lesson, not cultivation); its mark puts 素问's line for the foe's element at the door of the 大比's three bouts (the exits' game `hints`).

title.en: Hide the breath · The mirror's light

done_line.zh: 木牌凉了下去，凉得像一块冰。
done_line.en: The token cools, cold as ice.

title.en: Feeding the Rice Bucket · The night before

done_line.zh: 喷嚏符、痒痒针、自拍镜，末了一张画着猪的黄纸。
done_line.en: A sneezing charm, tickle needles, a selfie mirror, and last a yellow paper with a pig on it.

tasks._reward: What it makes is handed over by the way on (wm-zhaojing/sleep's grant: zipai-jing, penti-fu, yangyang-zhen ×3, niuzhi-ganlu) — story things every 大比 passage spends, so a skipped board still gives them.

title.en: The old records · Burn it after

done_line.zh: 纸上的字，他已经一个一个记进了肚子里。
done_line.en: Every word on it was already in his belly.

tasks._reward: The mark `diche` (all three lines by heart): 望气 in the 卢方 and 秦雁 bouts (the exits' game `sight`), and their lines at the door (`hints`).

title.en: The sneezing charm · Let the punch go by
The pig dragonfly · Wait for the wind to turn

tasks._reward: 修为 +5 for the bout; the result stays the book's — the final is lost, no 筑基丹.

tasks._game: Hanli 10-19 (「ai游戏放到游戏中吧……但要结合剧情」; 「AI猜都是Yinyue猜」): 娘 cannot read, so beside each line of his first letter home 小满 draws a small picture (games.json drawguess `sets.jiaxin`: the basins, 爹's bow, the moon over the mountain) and 银月 — out at the 火锅 that night — has to read it; a line counts as written once she names it, in words only when she does not. Never stuck on the model: she cannot be asked (a blind model, no engine, a 测试存档) and 「就写字吧」 writes it in words (`written`). Up to 3 looks a line, no opening look: ~8.7k tokens a look, 9 at most (~78k). Was the 写信 · 擦了又写 tap (games/letter.js, 游戏厅 only now).

title.en: The letter home · Drawn for Ma

deal.context: 腊八夜里，大通铺上，小满就着月光给家里写第一封信。娘不识字，他在每句旁边画一样东西

what.zh: 大比那天夜里，孙二狗托你替他写一封家信：「娘，我倒了七回，起来了七回。」别写是谁把他打倒的。
what.en: The night of the contest Sun Ergou asked you to write a letter home for him: "Mother, I fell down seven times and got up seven times." Not to write who knocked him down.

title.en: Reciting the opening · The Luo Shu

done_line.zh: 「戴九履一，左三右七，二四为肩，六八为足，五居中央。」
done_line.en: "Nine on the head, one under the feet… five in the middle."
